questions.subject: Warm-up
questions.prompt: In XP Daily, what does a streak survive?
options: Weekends and normal life — absence is neutral
A signed note from your mum
questions.answer: Weekends and normal life — absence is neutral
questions.why: Streaks count school days only. Weekends, sickness, and life don't break them — the system punishes nothing except silence on a school day.

questions.subject: Warm-up
questions.prompt: What is the ONLY job the AI has in this system?
questions.why: The ledger is the brain — plain deterministic code owns every mastery and scheduling decision. AI never keeps score.

questions.subject: Warm-up
questions.prompt: Year 8 rust check: what is 3/4 of 60?
questions.why: A quarter of 60 is 15, so three quarters is 45. If you reached for a calculator, Monday is going to be character-building.

questions.subject: Warm-up
questions.prompt: Teach it back (80+ characters): explain to another parent why XP Daily's texts only ever carry points and streaks — never scores out of ten, never what their kid got wrong.
questions.why: The no-ammunition law: a parent text must be impossible to turn into an interrogation. Gaps surface only where they arrive dressed as help.
